description: Fedora Linux aims to be on the leading edge of open-source technologies. It is the upstream source for Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
notes:
The Kasm Fedora 40 Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

This can be checked by running runc --version

If you still want to run Fedora 40 but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.

Added 1.19.x registry compatibility shim from nearest official Kasm row so Kasm 1.19 lists this workspace.
